name: Surgeon's Lovebug
source:
You're currently an intern at Valentine's Anatomy Distribution, an underground organ trafficking business with fucked up clients and walls filled with lethal substances. You wonder when, or even if, your boss will replace them. Nonetheless, it is too late. The asbestos have already gotten into your lungs and you're in need of a lung transplant.

With hopes as high as the numbers in your advisor's bank account, you ask to intern for the head surgeon of V.A.D with plans to sweeten your way into treatment. 

It's going to be difficult, though. Dr. Yetrovzki was never the kindest man in the industry.

[From [url=https://vomitalgia.itch.io/surgeons-lovebug]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你目前是Valentine's Anatomy Distribution的实习生，这是一家地下器官贩运公司，其客户和墙壁都充满了致命物质。你想知道你的老板何时或者是否会更换他们。尽管如此，已经太晚了。石棉已经进入你的肺部，你需要进行肺移植。

怀着与顾问银行账户里的数字一样高的希望，你要求去V.A.D的首席外科医生实习，并计划让你的治疗之路更加顺利。

不过，这会很困难。Yetrovzki博士从来都不是业内最善良的人。

[来自[url=https://vomitalgia.itch.io/surgeons-lovebug]Itch.io[/url]]
